reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin for reviewing coding-agent plans with anchored comments, multi-comment feedback, draft recovery, and approval or revision actions.

summaries.zh: 这是一个用于 DeepSeek Harness Web 的计划审阅插件，可对计划文本添加锚定批注、汇总结构化反馈并返回给编码代理。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin for adding anchored comments to coding-agent plans, compiling structured feedback, and returning it through the plan-review workflow.

capabilities: Adds an anchored plan-review interface to the DeepSeek Harness Web client
Collects multiple quoted annotations and overall feedback for a plan
Sends structured review feedback through DSH's existing response channel
Stores unfinished review drafts in browser local storage
